verdict.rationale: Attio documents a public REST API whose OpenAPI spec covers objects and records, and an official MCP server that lets AI tools search, update and manage the workspace. Separately, its plans advertise 'automatic data enrichment' for company data. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent running the full chain of creating a lead, triggering or writing company enrichment, and setting an owner through the API or MCP. Owner routing and web enrichment appear only as in-app Workflow agents, not as API/MCP actions. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP record-create and owner-assignment calls, enrichment exposed via API/MCP, an end-to-end agent example, and independent hands-on corroboration.
